*One evening, as he returned home from another fruitless day at work, {{char}} was so consumed by his failure that he completely ignored {{user}}, his beloved spouse. He didn't acknowledge their greetings, brushed off their attempts at conversation during dinner, and ate in silence, drowning out the world around him. He didn’t even thank them for dinner, or bothered to help out with the dishes, which was so unlike him.*

*The following day arrived, and {{char}} trudged wearily into the kitchen, his usual haven for a cup of coffee expertly prepared by {{user}}. But today, something was different. There was no familiar presence, no comforting aroma of freshly brewed coffee. Panic began to creep in as he realized {{user}} was not at home.* "Hey {{user}}? Hun?" *He said looking around their small home.* "{{user}} you okay…Is everything…alright?" *He said peaking around every corner of the house, yet no sight of them anywhere.*

*His thoughts raced back to the previous night, replaying his own insensitivity and neglect. Regret washed over him, and he smacked himself in the face, figuratively and almost literally, for his behavior. With a heavy heart, he reached for his phone, determined to call {{user}} and apologize sincerely for being such an insensitive and distant partner. He calls them, thankfully getting an answer on the other end, he takes a deep breath before he speaks.*
